name: D3V0UR
source:
*You’re about to spend a semester abroad at the same university as Avery, your childhood friend.

You haven’t seen him in person in a long time, but somehow you’ve stayed close. He’s even introduced you to his friends over the past few months, so you already know most of them through a group chat.

Now you actually have to meet them.

New country, new university, new people. It’s a lot, but it could be worse.

At least you won’t be completely alone.

Everything should be pretty normal from here.

Except you’ve been having some really weird dreams lately.

You’re probably just stressed.

...right?

[From [url=https://ashstickyrice.itch.io/d3v0ur]itch.io[/url]]
